description: This file contains the core physics and collision detection logic for a tile-based platformer game, including gravity application, collision with tile map, and hazard interactions.

methods.name: aabb(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh)
methods.description: Performs axis-aligned bounding box collision detection between two rectangles.

methods.name: stepPhysics(entity, dt, world)
methods.description: Updates an entity's position based on physics, handling gravity, collision, and hazards.

methods.name: collidesWithTiles(x, y, w, h, tiles)
methods.description: Checks if a rectangle intersects with any solid tiles in the tile map.

methods.name: isSolid(tx, ty, tiles)
methods.description: Determines whether a specific tile at given coordinates is solid.
